6                     NORTHERN DISTRICT OF CALIFORNIA                     
7                                                                         
8                                     Case No.  24-cv-00149-EKL           
9    IN RE CHARGEPOINT HOLDINGS, INC.                                     
                                                         (Consolidated)   
10    DERIVATIVE LITIGATION                                                
     _____________________________________                                
11                                     ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE AS TO           
                                      WHY THE CASE SHOULD NOT             
12    This Document Relates to:        BE STAYED                           
       ALL ACTIONS                                                        
13                                                                         
14                                                                         
15                                                                         
16        Having reviewed the Parties’ Joint Case Management statement filed on September 16, 
17   2024, ECF No. 51, it appears a stay in this action may be appropriate.  This case raises similar 
18   allegations to the securities class action that is before this Court in Khan v. ChargePoint Holdings, 
19   Inc., 23-cv-06172-EKL.  “Courts generally stay a shareholder derivative suit until the culmination 
20   of a securities class action when the cases arise from the same factual allegations and the evidence 
21   in the former could jeopardize the company’s defense in the latter.”  In re STEC, Inc. Derivative 
22   Litig., No. CV 10-00667-JVS (MLGx), 2012 WL 8978155, at *4 (C.D. Cal. Jan. 11, 2012); see also, 
23   e.g., In re RH S’holder Derivative Litig., No. 18-cv-02452-YGR, 2019 WL 580668, at *3–5 (N.D.
24   Cal. Jan. 23, 2019).                                                  
25                                                                         
26                                                                         
27   / /                                                                   
    1          The Parties shall meet and confer to discuss whether a stipulated stay may be entered in this 
    2  || case.  No later than November 1, 2024, the Parties shall file either a stipulation and proposed order 
    3    staying this case or a joint written response showing cause as to why this case should not be stayed. 
    4    Unless otherwise ordered, the matter will be taken under submission without oral argument.  The 
    5    Court sets a status conference on February 12, 2025, at 1:30 p.m. via Zoom.  This hearing will be 
    6  || vacated if this action is stayed. 
    7          IT IS SO ORDERED. 
    8    Dated:  October 1, 2024 
    9 
   10 
                                                        Eumi K. Lee 
   I                                                    United States District Judge
